LOGIC ADVENTURE 11 · CLASS 30

Elephant’s Size Sorting Circus

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Size matching

A mouse, a dog, an elephant — match every circus friend to the right-sized tent.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · SIZE MATCHING

Elephant’s Size Sorting Circus

Match each animal to the right-sized tent. Tap the animal, then the tent.

Tap an animal, then tap the tent that fits.

The circus is sorted!

Mouse in the small tent, dog in the medium, elephant in the large.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains size matching on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Elephant’s Size Sorting Circus worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
